closes: finding F12 of plans/reports/MSCA_DN_Readiness_Audit_2026-10-08.md, and V12's share of F04. The evidence half of F04 stays with V13, which this ticket unblocks.
authority: Agent-authored under CLAUDE.md. Advisory, out-of-band QA. Closes no gate and confers no authority. The runbook describes an execution this repository does not perform, and acceptance is the operator's.
decision: The PE-09 runbook is corrected to describe only what the code does, and its operational claims are bound to a test rather than to a review. Every documented command line is read back against its own --help, the enumerated freeze conditions are compared with BASELINE_CHECKS, and every path, test module and test class it cites must exist.
why: The runbook is the only artifact of this milestone a human executes, and it executes in a private network nobody here can watch. A stale claim is therefore discovered by the operator, mid-run, at the cost of a step. It had already happened once: V06 made --grounding-scope required and every documented preflight and assess line was wrong until V06 corrected them. A reviewed document decays at the speed of the code; a measured one fails in this suite instead.

corrections.claim_before: The freeze checks fifteen baseline conditions, including the planted-marker test.
corrections.now: The freeze runs 22 conditions, enumerated in Section 5 in the order it runs them, and no marker check is among them. The planted-marker test is cited where it belongs, among the transport and isolation controls.

corrections.claim_before: Checkpointing is a flag to remember: 'record every call's response through the checkpoint (--checkpoint, --resume)'.
corrections.now: Checkpointing is the default. The default path, the three flags that change it, the verbatim discard record a malformed response leaves, the two-redraw budget and the salvage command are all stated, and the private handoff records the exact checkpoint path.

corrections.claim_before: The 2025 call text and work programme are not stored in this repository, so the historical profile is a hand-authored copy of the 2026 profile with its differences listed.
corrections.now: V09 pinned the 2025 authorities and V10 authored the profile from the equivalence matrix over them. Section 3 names both profiles, the pinned index, the matrix, the two checking commands and the two elements whose matrix rows are still open.

corrections.claim_before: The importer reads a fixed revision table and takes only --check and --repo-root; the original cannot be imported until the table is made selectable.
corrections.now: V07 made the configuration selectable. Section 4 runs --document official_original --describe, reports the five required fields that configuration still lacks, and routes the measurement through V08's dry-import procedure.

corrections.claim_before: A cross-baseline diff command on the success path, with a paragraph underneath saying it will be refused.
corrections.now: No command line names the public comparison. The refusal is explained where the command stood, the replacement is a labelled row-by-observation reading, and the diff command that remains is the one that applies: two comparisons over the same private baseline.

corrections.claim_before: Stage B uses 'the commands of Sections 4 to 6', with one sentence excusing compare.
corrections.now: Stage B reuses Sections 4 and 5 and the audit command alone. compare, review and diff do not apply, because the resubmission has no evaluation summary report of its own.

corrections.claim_before: The model and version pins read as properties of the run.
corrections.now: They are declared identifiers. The report records model@version and nothing else about the assessor, and neither string attests that the named model answered. The pinned temperature of 0 reaches no provider, because the claude CLI takes no temperature argument; robustness comes from majority voting over N samples.

corrections.claim_before: Isolation was listed as enforced controls, with no statement of what they are not.
corrections.now: The three controls stay, each with its test. Beside them: an external working directory is not an operating-system sandbox, and disabling tools is not authorisation to send private proposal content to a provider. Section 10 and the prerequisites govern that.

new_lane_area.name: handoff
new_lane_area.why_not_depended_on: The runbook governs the private PE-09 execution. This repository's historical run does not read it.

verification.the_guard_is_not_vacuous: A mutation run renamed --grounding-scope to --grounding-scopes on one line and dropped the final 's' from one condition name. Three checks failed: the documented-flag check, the required-flag check and the enumeration check. The runbook was restored from a copy taken before the mutation.
verification.help_output: Every flag is read from the command's own --help through this interpreter. No command but --help, --check, --describe and --environment was executed.
verification.prose: The repository's prose linter passes on the runbook: no errors.
verification.quota: none spent. No assessor ran, no runner phase was dispatched, no scoring was performed, and the frozen 74.60 baseline is untouched.
verification.two_axis_review: A standards review and a spec review ran in parallel over the finished change. Five findings were acted on: the salvage line gained --n, --criterion-n and --out-dir, which bind the checkpoint; section 6 no longer collides with section 5 on a step number; the same-baseline diff names the input that produces its after-side; the investigation list has its own heading rather than reading as that diff's output; and harness/HARNESS.md no longer says the lane document names sixteen areas. Three were declined with a stated reason, recorded in the report's section 10.
verification.full_suite: 7,575 passed, 194 failed, 86 skipped. The failures are the branch's known whole-run inflation, measured at 207 on 2026-10-07 against 54 per directory. None is in a module this ticket touches.

known_gaps: The runbook still describes an execution that has not happened. Nothing here is a result.
Five required fields of the original's document configuration are undeclared, so the original cannot be imported on this build.
No tool compares two comparisons over different baselines. The cross-baseline reading stays a labelled manual reading.
The grounding axis stays unassessable for an imported proposal until ticket X01.
The operator's pre-run evidence about the assessor CLI, its version and the permitted processing route is a record without a validator until V13.

The runbook is over its length budget. docs/style/internal-docs-profile.md section 5 budgets a Plan at 2,500 words and says an over-budget document is split rather than compressed; the runbook was 2,525 words before this ticket and is 3,577 now. Compressing it would undo the ticket, so the report proposes the smallest split - section 2, whose deferral table already exists as a register - and leaves the decision to the operator.
not_evidence_of: that PE-09 has been executed, or that any command here has been run against the original
that the private environment permits any content to leave it
that the documented sequence is sufficient, only that each command it names exists with the flags it names
that V12 is accepted. Acceptance is the operator's.

side_effect.now: It holds that the section keeps the G4 acceptance's limit as written, and that a checked box is accompanied by the dated status of the work that closed it.
side_effect.basis: the test fails on an undated closure and passes on the dated one
